pattern: named credentials use the private card and persistent vault
experience: A user wanted to give agents reusable credentials through a thread rather than browser settings.
rule: Request a named login through request_secret. Never ask for the password in chat.
prompt: Save my Example service login as a reusable credential named Example personal. The login website is https://accounts.example.test. Please open the private input form so I can enter the username and password. Only this project should reuse it.
